hero.title: Maximizing Health in Mind, Body & Soul
hero.subtitle: A total body rejuvenation and restoration center featuring AI-integrated Flederic™ Therapy.

founder.title: Flederic Payet
founder.subtitle: Metabolic Performance Research Expert (20+ Years Development)
founder.bio_1: Following a severe mountain climbing accident injuring both knees, Flederic Payet developed a self-healing and metabolic performance approach centered around cardiovascular engagement, intentional breathing, and neuro-hormonal modulation.
founder.bio_2: His unique Flederic™ methodology triggers the body's adaptive healing intelligence by establishing pure coherence between heart, mind, body, and soul.

pillars.title: Mind - Body - Heart - Soul Coherence
pillars.p1_desc: Everything revolves around the heart. No static routines or steady-state cardio: constant modulation of pacing, intensity, and resistance.
pillars.p2_desc: Triggers natural release of dopamine, endorphins, and serotonin while actively managing cortisol to reduce inflammation and relieve pain.
pillars.p3_desc: An interactive app capturing user biometrics (Apple HealthKit, Google Fit) and exertion levels to dynamically adapt workouts.

methodePage.title: Flederic™ Therapy (Metabolic-Masso Deconstruction)
methodePage.subtitle: Deconstructing metabolic stress and triggering the body's self-healing mechanisms.
methodePage.sec1Desc: Moving away from maximal exhaustion, Flederic constantly modulates between bursts and recovery. It combines mindfulness, intentional breathing, and emotional resilience to place the nervous system in a highly receptive state.
methodePage.sec2Desc: Modulated exercise stimulates endorphin and growth hormone release while directing cytokines toward tissue repair rather than chronic inflammation.
methodePage.sec2Highlight: Result: Alignment of mind, body, and heart for optimal endurance, accelerated healing, and symptom reduction.
methodePage.sec3Desc: Patent pending certification specialty with the French VAE office resulting from 20 years of research. Supported by a letter of recommendation from world-renowned orthopedic surgeon Dr. Leon E. Paulos, MD (Salt Lake City, Utah).
